title: KBD native-kbd change task ledger
description: tasks.json is the SOURCE OF TRUTH for per-task state in the native-kbd spec backend, at .kbd-orchestrator/changes/<change-id>/tasks.json. Designed for one-task-per-turn driving by kbd-apply: nk_mark_done is an atomic jq mutation carrying doneBy/doneAt for the cross-tool ledger. tasks.md is a GENERATED human view regenerated after every mutation — never the source of truth.

id.description: Stable explicit task id (e.g. "1", "1.2", "verify"). Unlike OpenSpec's positional ordinals, native ids are explicit and survive reordering.

doneAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC completion timestamp; null until done.

doneBy.description: Tool that completed the task (KBD_TOOL); the cross-tool ledger field.

files.description: Optional declared file touch-set for this task.

verify.description: Optional shell command that must exit 0 for this task to count verified.
